store.summary: Nomad SDR: ham receiver for RTL-SDR with band plan, APRS, recording, fox hunt
store.description: Part of the Nomad tools by Tech Nomad Ted, TheTechNomad.com. A ham-friendly receiver for RTL-SDR dongles (made for the RTL-SDR Blog V3). Listen with NFM, AM, USB, LSB, CW and broadcast FM with filter, gain, squelch, AGC and PPM controls, live spectrum and a signal meter. The US band plan shows what each part of a band is for and whether your license class (Technician, General, Extra) may transmit there, with repeater offsets and one key to listen on a repeater's input. HF (0.5-28.8 MHz) through the V3's direct sampling or an upconverter. Record to WAV, then play, download from a web page by QR code, or copy to a USB stick. Bias-tee switch for LNAs and active antennas. APRS receive on 144.390 shows stations with distance and hands every packet to Rig Companion's list and map. Fox-hunt meter with peak hold, trend and a rising tone. Keys 4-8: Mode, Freq, Rec, Band, Menu. Fn+H shows help. Needs an RTL-SDR dongle on USB.
